newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian inflation in 1997 to drop back - study.
newsitem.headline: Belgian inflation in 1997 to drop back - study.

text.p: Belgian inflation will drop back in 1997 as recent price pressures moderate, Belgium's Federal Economic Planning Office said on Thursday.
The Planning Office forecast inflation would average around 1.8 percent. Inflation in November, the last month for which data is available, was 2.36 percent.
The Planning Office said inflation should fall back as the impact of recent indirect tax increases lessens and oil prices reverse their recent climb.
